_comment_wan_support: WAN transport supported: TCP only. Set remote.transport to 'tcp'.

remote._comment_initial_peers: TCP physical port = 7400 + 250 * domain_id (domain 1 → 7650). Override with INT2DDS_TCP_PORT.
remote._comment_tls: Remove the 'tls' block to use plain TCP. All three PEM paths are required when TLS is enabled.
